info.title: Board-certified lawyers by practice area and state: specialist counts from official state lists (Tennessee and Minnesota): data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Board-certified lawyers by practice area and state: specialist counts from official state lists (Tennessee and Minnesota): How many lawyers hold a board certification in each practice area, state by state, counted from the official lists of certified specialists that Tennessee's Commission on Continuing Legal Education and Minnesota's Board of Legal Certification publish. Each row is a state, a practice area and a certifying body, with the number of certified specialists. Minnesota's rows run by year; Tennessee's are the roll as read on the date shown. Counts only: no names or personal details.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
